  > - Figures: 1 protocol (fig1_protocol); 2 ratio vs n (fig2_ratio_vs_n); 3 bias by score (fig3_bias_by_score); 4 ceiling (fig5_ceiling); appendix 5 design x estimator heat map (fig4_ablation); appendix 6 number of sources (fig5b_msrc); appendix 7 ordering (fig6_ordering).
  > - Tables: 1 primary endpoint (table2_primary); 2 data audit (table1_audit); 3 bias/variance (table3_biasvar); 4 ranking quality (table4_ordering); 5 leave-one-benchmark-out (table2_lobo); 6 secondary endpoint 2% (table2_twopct); 7 by suite (table2_suite); 9 robustness (table_robust); 10 every method (table2_primary_all). (Table 8 is not yours.)
  > The simplest way is to rename the files to the paper's numbers (fig4_ceiling.pdf, tables table1_primary.tex and so on) and update make_all.sh; if you do, tell me the new names in one list so I update the \input and \includegraphics paths in the same push to dev, or copy files and I will fix the paths. Either is fine; the README and captions are what must match.
  > Also (M1): the heat map is now in a [t] float after a \clearpage in appendix/data.tex, which fixes the overflow; nothing needed from you unless you want it larger.
